title: Agentic Brand Management
summary: An evidence-graded brand and creator-management monitor coordinating collection, disclosure, claims-risk, brand-fit, measurement, governance, and accountable human sign-off.
audience: Regulated and reputation-sensitive brands using AI-assisted content and creator systems.
implementationStatus: Public demonstration with browser-local scoring and illustrative, dated signal records.
documentation: Filter illustrative signals by risk level
Score governance coverage before production use
assumptions: Production monitoring would use authorized brand, platform, and campaign data
limitations: Demonstration records are illustrative
No external account is connected and no recommendation is executed

title: AI Creative Production Intelligence
summary: A monitor for converting ad-hoc AI generation into a repeatable, on-brand production pipeline with reference controls, revision tracking, quality gates, and visible provenance.
audience: AI filmmakers, creative directors, studio founders, and producers accountable for consistency at volume.
implementationStatus: Public demonstration with browser-local production-coverage scoring.
documentation: Treat outputs as a production-design starting point
assumptions: Production teams can preserve references and review outputs at defined gates
limitations: The monitor does not render media
Illustrative signals do not measure a real studio pipeline

title: Collection & Audience AI Intelligence
summary: A mission-grounded monitor for museums, galleries, and arts nonprofits evaluating AI applications through provenance, accessibility, collection metadata, and audience stewardship.
audience: Museum directors, curators, registrars, gallery leaders, and arts-nonprofit executives.
implementationStatus: Public concept monitor with browser-local stewardship-coverage scoring.
assumptions: Institution-specific records and standards are available to the accountable team
limitations: Illustrative records are not an institutional collection audit
Cultural authority cannot be inferred from metadata alone

title: Biopharma Regulatory Intelligence Layer
summary: A primary-source-grounded monitor for clinical-stage drug programs covering development gates, review timing, exclusivity, controlled-substance tracks, and dated regulatory changes.
audience: Regulatory affairs teams, counsel, founders, boards, and clinical-stage sponsors.
implementationStatus: Public demonstration; no sponsor program or live regulatory feed is connected.
documentation: Verify every current conclusion against primary authority
evidence: FDA and other agency primary sources
methodology: Escalate material changes to accountable experts
assumptions: A production implementation has authorized program facts and current primary-source access
limitations: Not regulatory or legal advice
Illustrative signals do not state the status of a real drug program

title: Neuro-Architecture & Biophilic Design Intelligence
summary: A neuroscience-grounded monitor for evaluating how space may support human nervous systems through daylight, nature views, fascination, prospect and refuge, materials, acoustics, air, and thermal quality.
audience: Architects, design researchers, urban designers, and interior or workplace leaders.
implementationStatus: Public research demonstration with browser-local mechanism-coverage scoring.
documentation: Use qualified measurement and design review for real projects

signals.title: Daylight exposure and glare considered together

evidence: Peer-reviewed environmental neuroscience and design research
assumptions: A real project can collect relevant environmental and human-outcome measures
limitations: Research findings do not guarantee individual outcomes
This demonstration is not a design, medical, or accessibility assessment

title: Luxury Brand Protection & Anti-Counterfeiting Intelligence
summary: An IP-risk and counterfeit-signal monitor for luxury and consumer brands, linking each recommended review path to identified rights, evidence, platforms, jurisdictions, and accountable counsel.
audience: IP counsel, luxury and fashion houses, brand-protection leads, boards, and investors.
implementationStatus: Public demonstration; no marketplace, rights database, or enforcement system is connected.
documentation: Require counsel review before any notice or action
assumptions: A production implementation has authorized access to rights and marketplace records
limitations: Not legal advice
No takedown or enforcement action is generated or sent

title: Market & Competitive Intelligence Monitor
summary: A primary-source-grounded monitor for competitor moves, pricing, customer sentiment, hiring, funding, filings, IP, and regulation, with every signal dated and confidence-scored.
audience: Founders, strategy teams, brand leaders, and regulated or reputation-sensitive organizations.
implementationStatus: Public demonstration with browser-local coverage scoring and illustrative signal records.
documentation: Verify consequential decisions against current evidence

signals.title: Rule change may alter market timing

assumptions: The monitored market and competitors are explicitly bounded
limitations: Illustrative signals are not a current market report
Absence of a signal is not evidence that no change occurred

title: Private-AI & Data-Retention Risk Monitor
summary: A governance monitor for privileged, health, trade-secret, personal, or regulated data entering AI systems, focused on retention, subprocessors, human access, training use, and zero-retention controls.
audience: General counsel, privacy and compliance leaders, healthcare teams, and trade-secret owners.
implementationStatus: Public demonstration; no vendor account, confidential data, or live configuration is inspected.
documentation: Verify vendor terms and configurations directly
evidence: Current vendor terms and privacy documentation
methodology: Require accountable privacy, security, and legal review
assumptions: Production review has access to the actual contract, settings, architecture, and data classes
limitations: Not a security test or legal opinion
Do not enter confidential or personal information into this demonstration

title: Psychedelic Regulatory Radar
summary: A primary-source-grounded status monitor separating psilocybin programs, MDMA-related federal developments, ketamine practice and telehealth, and state–federal legal layers.
audience: Psychedelic-health organizations, ketamine platforms, legal operations teams, counsel, funders, and boards.
implementationStatus: Public demonstration; illustrative records are not a statement of current law.
documentation: Filter illustrative substance and jurisdiction signals
Verify the current jurisdiction, activity, and authority

signals.title: State program rule requires jurisdiction-specific review
Federal therapeutic status must be dated
Practice and telehealth rules require separate analysis

evidence: Current federal and state primary authority
assumptions: The user verifies every consequential conclusion against current authority
limitations: Informational only and not legal or medical advice
Illustrative signals must not be treated as current law

title: Content Suppression & Platform Visibility Audit
summary: A platform-policy-grounded monitor for health and wellness content visibility, separating claims risk, advertising eligibility, off-platform links, sensitive audiences, and evidence-backed recovery actions.
audience: Health and wellness brands, visibility strategists, regulated-industry creators, and clinicians who publish.
implementationStatus: Public demonstration; no social account, reach data, or platform API is connected.
documentation: Verify current platform policies before changing content
evidence: Current platform policy and advertising rules
methodology: Preserve the content and reach record
Map observable patterns to current policy categories
assumptions: Production analysis has authorized access to account-level content and analytics
limitations: Platforms rarely disclose complete ranking logic
Correlation does not prove suppression or its cause
